title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
description: Sharks were swimming the oceans millions of years before the first trees grew on land.

scenes.text: Sharks are older than trees. That sounds wrong, but it is true.
The earliest sharks appeared roughly four hundred and fifty million years ago, in ancient seas.
The first true trees did not show up on land until around three hundred and eighty five million years ago.
That means sharks have survived several mass extinctions, including the one that wiped out the dinosaurs.
The next time you walk through a forest, remember that sharks were here first. Follow for more weird facts.
